_comment: Cost of each outcome = fixed + pct_of_amount * transaction amount. Edit to match your portfolio; make run re-selects the threshold.

false_negative.note: missed fraud: issuer absorbs the full amount plus ~$25 dispute/chargeback handling

false_positive.note: false decline of a good customer: ~$12 servicing and attrition risk plus 3% lost interchange/spend

true_positive.note: correct decline: ~$6 alert handling and customer contact
